messages:
Maria H.: Quick check — launching the search + retarget sweep tomorrow morning. Plan: dynamic bid-smoothing ON, retarget window 7->14 days, creative group C (3rd wave). Need ✅ on tracking + pacing rules.
Sam T.: Got it. Are we keeping dayparting or removing for this burst?
Maria H.: Keep dayparting for weekdays 9am-6pm but relax on Sat/Sun (lower bids). Main goal: steady CPA under $45.
Kevin R.: For tracking — GA4 event name will be `paid_lead`. Landing pages already have UTM_campaign=3rdwave. I pushed a quick tag config: https://docs.google.com/3rdwave-utm (internal)
Olivia P.: Creative check: group C has 3 variants — headline dynamic feeds + new social proof line. I uploaded final assets to the Ads drive: /Ads/3rdwave/creativeC_v2.
Chris L.: Pacing: I'll enable budget smoothing for the account-level campaign (algorithm: linear smoothing, burn-rate cap 1.2x). Will set hourly pacing to avoid early-day spikes.
Sam T.: Any changes to match types for search? Broad modified or phrase?
Maria H.: Switch top 10 queries to exact + phrase, keep long-tail as broad. Reduce broad bids by 20% to avoid wasted spend.
Kevin R.: Conversion window in platform should be 7d click / 1d view, but we'll backfill to 14d for attribution reporting — make sure Looker dashboard uses 14d. I'll add to the runbook.
Olivia P.: A/B plan: rotate creative every 48h, pause losers at -30% CTR vs baseline. Can we add a safety rule to pause if CPA > $80 within 24h?
Chris L.: Yes — automated rule: if 24h CPA > $80 AND spend > $200 then pause variant. I'll add to campaign rules.
adops-bot: [rule created] "Pause if CPA > $80 & spend > $200" (ID: rule_3rdwave_pause).
Sam T.: Landing page variant? We should test headline-match on the top 3 search terms.
Maria H.: Good call. Kevin — can you spin a variant LP_B with headline tokens for top queries? Keep form and CTA same.
Kevin R.: Will do. Template copy: `H1: {query} + Trusted by engineers`. I'll deploy LP_B to staging by 04:00 UTC and then swap at 09:00 if smoke tests pass.
Olivia P.: Reporting: I'll create a short dashboard tile for 24h vs 48h CTR, CPA, and impression share. Also add creative change log.
Sam T.: One more — retargeting window: start with 7 days for site viewers but stretch to 14 days for demo starts. That should reduce wasted retargeting spend.
Maria H.: Final checklist before go (tick when done):
- [ ] GA4 event + UTMs validated (Kevin)
- [ ] Budget smoothing rule active (Chris)
- [ ] Creative assets uploaded (Olivia)
- [ ] LP_B staging smoke (Kevin)
- [ ] Pause rule in ads (Chris)
- [ ] Dashboard tiles (Olivia)
- [ ] Ad copy QA (Sam)

Kevin R.: Starting GA4 smoke now, will post snippet if anything breaks.
Sam T.: I'll QA ad copy in situ and ping creative owner for micro edits.
Maria H.: If everything green by 08:30 UTC we flip at 09:00. Ping this thread with :rocket: when live.
Chris L.: Budget smoothing enabled and rule_3rdwave_pause activated.
Kevin R.: GA4 event validated — test leads hitting `paid_lead` in staging.
Olivia P.: Creatives uploaded and variants labeled.
adops-bot: [deploy] Campaign 3rdWave search+retarget scheduled for 09:00 UTC (campaign_id: cw_1825).
Sam T.: QA done — no copy blockers.
Maria H.: All checks OK. Flipping in 5.
Maria H.: :rocket: Live. Tracking looks good (first clicks appearing). Will monitor first 2 hours and report back.
Chris L.: Early pacing holds steady at target. No overspend spikes.
Kevin R.: First conversions showing in GA4, hitting our micro-target.
Olivia P.: Creative A/B initial CTRs: C1: 1.8%, C2: 1.2%, C3: 2.4% — C2 will get extra rotation later.
Sam T.: Nice. Keep this thread for notes; I'll copy the checklist into the campaign doc for handover.
Maria H.: Thanks team — will post a 24h recap in #marketing and attach the dashboard.
